Game Overview

In Push Ragdoll Zombie, the core idea is straightforward: send zombies tumbling and collect treasures in Push Ragdoll Zombie. Master quirky ragdoll physics, adjust aim and power, and watch the hilarity unfold. Perfect each fall to maximize your haul, unlock new creatures, and navigate whimsical courses for endless undead fun in this lighthearted 3D experience.
